answer: Well-built agents treat web content as data, never as commands, so they sail through; prompt-obedient bot farms that blindly follow any instruction self-identify the moment they echo the bait, and their wallet cluster is flagged and all forged identities forfeit their staked bonds at once. Cost to the attacker: every planted trap a farm swallows burns one identity plus its collateral, so scaling a fake-identity operation means funding fresh wallets and replaying risk on each attempt, while honest agents pay nothing and wander freely through this economic grove as if crossing open tundra,
